item.title: Pothole in the road problem, 29th October
item.description:
IM ringing as your resurfacing my road why are you doing this at night time - i explained that this is a busy road and thats why we do it at night to have less impact on vehicles in the day she said the company vans have R AND R REServicing all over them - they are causing my mental health to go bad if i get locked up tonight from smashing my head in with a hammer your gonna hear about this im disgusted that we wasnt told that this road was being resurfaced , im gonna go sort them out myself if you dont do something about this. i have called the police and they told me to call youas apparently this isnt breaching the peace.. this is destroying my mental health and i need sleep tonight. I want compensation for this as im now not going to sleep at all tonight , im gonna go crazy. i explained that i cant do complaints or claims OOH she asked what was an emergancy line used for if she cant make a complaint , i explained i deal with emergancy road closures, RTC and trees being down. i said leave it with me and ill try and sort this.

item.description:

item.title: SUGGESTION : Could you add a LARGER 'Keep left' sign please ?, 28th October
item.description:
SUGGESTION : Hi, could you add a LARGER 'Keep left' sign please on the northside traffic light island ? Today I witnessed a car travelling from stationary (ie, from a red light) from Parton Road to Innsworth Lane (north) via the outbound right turn lane from Innsworth Lane ; there were southbound cars waiting on the left / ahead lane, but this driver simply drove past them and headed towards the NATO camp. Traffic needs to be accurately directed to the left hand side of the island. Please note, this occurrence has also been reported several times recently in local social media. Thankyou, Nat, Churchdown driving instructor.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 397-399, Innsworth Lane, Churchdown, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Bridge looks on verge of collapse, 28th October
item.description:
Along the footpath besides Norman's Brook leading from the B4063, and within Brickhampton golf course, there is a small footbridge. Besides this there is also a much older brick tunnel structure that looks like it might once have supported a bridge. This looks like it is on the verge of collapse which would block the Brook and also potentially pose other dangers.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road, Elmbridge, Gloucester
